derivation: from an unused root meaning to go around or bind;

words.word: and they shall be as frontlets
that they may be as frontlets

occurrences.text: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the Lord brought us forth out of Egypt.
And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
words: and they shall be as frontlets

occurrences.text: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
